name: Crossref Computer Science Papers Downsampled Source-Schema Subset
description: Downsampled Crossref metadata records used as benchmark input for the papers web-data-integration usecase. The file preserves a Crossref-shaped source schema instead of the integrated schema. Rows are ordered like the schema-mapped Crossref subset so existing identity-resolution identifiers remain stable. Records are taken from the local Crossref source snapshots where available; missing DOI rows are represented in the same Crossref-shaped schema from the downsampled values.

variableMeasured.name: container_title
variableMeasured.description: Crossref container, venue, journal, or proceedings title

variableMeasured.name: abstract_text
variableMeasured.description: Crossref abstract or descriptive subject text where available

variableMeasured.name: page_first
variableMeasured.description: First page or first page locator reported by Crossref

variableMeasured.name: page_last
variableMeasured.description: Last page or last page locator reported by Crossref

variableMeasured.name: reference_total
variableMeasured.description: Number of references reported by Crossref

variableMeasured.name: cited_total
variableMeasured.description: Number of citing works reported by Crossref
